minor.issue: Returns 404 'Clé inconnue.' for unknown key_id before signature verify, while /accounts/visit returns 403 first. Inconsistent gate-order — fine functionally (both reject), but 404 could be considered enum-leak (signal that key_id is unknown vs invalid sig). Low priority.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L3987-4062 /api/ai/wizard-suggest — seed-driven fallback works: _rnd.seed(seed_val) gives reproducible variety across seeds. _fallback_name_pool has 55 entries spanning lengths 3-12. Good. Minor: when LLM JSON parse succeeds but lacks 'suggestions' key for kind=='name', the last-resort placeholder at L4058 is ['NovaApp','PixelForge','Lumino'] — these are the EXACT names the prompt tells GPT to avoid. Recommend replacing with another _rnd.sample(_fallback_name_pool(),3) so variety holds even on validation failure paths.

server.py L6032-6110 /api/export/download — pydantic ExportRequest correctly accepts include_code and include_chat with defaults (True, False). Backend honors both flags: include_code gates the file writes + README, include_chat appends chat-transcript.md + chat-transcript.docx. project_type=='chat' forces transcript inclusion. Clean implementation.

Click on project filters messages by project_id. Good UX.

Dashboard.js L1194-1233 zip-options modal — z-[130], backdrop-blur-sm, onClick(backdrop)=close, project name displayed, two checkboxes with correct defaults (code=true, chat=false), 'Télécharger' button .disabled when (!includeCode && !includeChat).
